default_launch.eac_observation_note: Checked at three points (pre-launch, immediately after MCC-Win64-Shipping.exe started, and after the main menu was reached): no process and no loaded module matching eac/anticheat/easyanticheat (case-insensitive) was found, despite easyanticheat/settings.json (E-P0B1-007) shipping in the install tree and naming this same executable as its target. Only a static, point-in-time process/module check was performed; no attempt was made to enter an online match or matchmaking flow to see if EAC loads later under network play, which is out of this rung's scope.

default_launch.online_status_indicator: Appears online/connected; no offline banner or connectivity warning observed.

shutdown_behavior.operator_perception: Did not close immediately; appeared to hang.
shutdown_behavior.process_check_result: By the time the process tree was re-checked, MCC-Win64-Shipping.exe, wineserver, winedevice, and the reaper/launcher chain had all exited. Only a defunct (already-terminated, awaiting reap) gameoverlayui helper process remained, which is normal Steam-overlay cleanup residue, not a hung game process.
shutdown_behavior.conclusion: Shutdown was delayed/non-instant but completed without a force-kill.
